# NIS2-Nastroje.cz

> The only Czech-language independent comparison hub for NIS2/NÚKIB compliance tools — helping obligated Czech companies cut evaluation time from weeks to hours by providing localised, regulation-specific tool reviews, side-by-side feature matrices, and NÚKIB-aligned scoring so they choose the right software before enforcement deadlines hit

NIS2-Nastroje.cz covers Cybersecurity Compliance (NIS2 Directive & NÚKIB Regulatory Tools for Czech SMEs and Enterprises) for CZ, SK.
